summary: A cell culture process in aqueous medium wants to move glucose and lactate measurement from delayed sample-based laboratory analysis towards an in situ spectroscopy pilot, with the existing laboratory measurements used as the comparison. The medium and cell population change during the run, and no probe or calibration strategy has been chosen.
